data.reason: Each run of the example writes shelf's reference into the workspace, so tests/docs.rs runs docs with a file in a temporary directory instead.
costs: The examples are not run, so help can show an example that fails.
The command's output weight counts 0 bytes, so its path weight is too low.

data.reason: Each failure of weigh and docs comes from cargo, a build or the tool that it runs, so a test provokes one only by building a broken workspace.
costs: No test shows that the command's recoveries lead anywhere, so a recovery can lead back to the same failure or name a command that no longer runs.
